newsitem.title: JAPAN: JT plans 150-200 bln yen Tokyo redevelopment -- Jiji.
newsitem.headline: JT plans 150-200 bln yen Tokyo redevelopment -- Jiji.

text.p: Japan Tobacco Inc is planning a 150 billion to 200 billion yen redevelopment project in Tokyo to include office buildings, shopping centres and apartments, Jiji news agency said on Wednesday.
The report said other companies were likely to participate in the project, which would be headed by JT.
JT declined to comment on the report, which said that the complex, to be built on about 76,000 square metres of land in Tokyo's Shinagawa area, was expected to be completed by 2005.
A JT plant used to be on the site, Jiji said.
